text: Consolidate SSRF unsafe-address classification onto ONE shared predicate consumed by fetch/url_policy.py (live crawl path, H6/064-F), fetch/http.py, and fetch/sitemap.py (_is_unsafe_address, 065-F). After 064-F(H6) + 065-F land, the CGNAT 100.64.0.0/10 membership check exists as TWO independent copies (url_policy vs sitemap) plus metadata/class flags - divergent reject-lists are a known SSRF drift footgun on a security-critical predicate. Deliberation Option B (deferred). Surface a per-surface coverage matrix and refactor to a single canonical classifier so a future address-class fix cannot be applied to one copy and forgotten in the other. Flagged by PR#166 cycle-16 adversarial review (Security P3 + Architecture P2/borders-P1). Grounded: src/docline/fetch/url_policy.py, fetch/http.py, fetch/sitemap.py:173-189.
